_comment: Reasons used by scripts/hutool_coverage.py. 'modules' excludes a whole upstream module,
'classes' excludes a single fully qualified class. Every reason must name the capability
that Kotlin common code cannot provide, so a reader can verify it against the Java source.

modules.hutool-ai: Talks to remote model endpoints through java.net sockets and needs per-vendor credentials; a KMP port belongs in a separate HTTP-based module.
modules.hutool-all: Aggregator POM: contains only two dependency-descriptor classes, no logic to port.
modules.hutool-aop: JDK dynamic proxies and bytecode libraries (Javassist/CGLib); there is no equivalent interception mechanism in commonMain.
modules.hutool-bom: Bill-of-materials POM with dependency management only; no classes exist to port.
modules.hutool-captcha: Renders images with java.awt.Graphics2D; commonMain has no 2D graphics backend.
modules.hutool-db: Built on JDBC (java.sql.Connection/ResultSet); KMP persistence has to choose a driver per platform instead.
modules.hutool-extra: Servlet/FTP/mail/QR-code/template wrappers around javax.* and JVM-only libraries.
modules.hutool-http: java.net.HttpURLConnection and javax.net.ssl; the multiplatform equivalent is an HTTP client such as Ktor, which users add themselves.
modules.hutool-poi: Apache POI reads and writes Office files through java.io and java.awt; JVM-only.
modules.hutool-socket: java.net sockets plus NIO channels; no socket API in commonMain.
modules.hutool-system: java.lang.management, OSHI and JVM process introspection; per-OS data must come from expect/actual code.

packages.cn.hutool.core.annotation: Annotation metadata and scanners read java.lang.annotation through reflection, which commonMain does not expose.
packages.cn.hutool.core.bean: The bean layer copies properties through java.lang.reflect.Field/Method and java.lang.reflect.Type.
packages.cn.hutool.core.comparator: Comparators resolve bean properties or Pinyin collation through reflection/JVM text APIs.
packages.cn.hutool.core.compiler: Compiles Java sources with javax.tools; no compiler API exists in commonMain.
packages.cn.hutool.core.convert.impl: Each converter dispatches on java.lang.reflect.Type or a JVM-specific value type.
packages.cn.hutool.core.getter: Basic-type getters serve the reflection-based bean layer that the port replaces with explicit accessors.
packages.cn.hutool.core.img: Image operations need java.awt.image and ImageIO.
packages.cn.hutool.core.io.file: Paths, streams, file visitors and tailers are java.io/java.nio only.
packages.cn.hutool.core.io.resource: Resources wrap InputStream, URL, File or the classpath.
packages.cn.hutool.core.io.copy: Copiers move java.io streams and channels.
packages.cn.hutool.core.lang.reflect: Method handles, lookups and generic type resolution are JVM APIs.
packages.cn.hutool.core.lang.loader: Class loaders and resource loaders are JVM concepts.
packages.cn.hutool.core.net: Sockets, SSL contexts and URL connections come from java.net/javax.net.
packages.cn.hutool.core.text.csv: CSV readers/writers are built on java.io Reader/Writer and files.
packages.cn.hutool.log.dialect: Every logging dialect bridges a JVM framework (SLF4J, Log4j, JUL, JBoss, TinyLog); users supply their own logger in KMP.

classes.cn.hutool.core.bean.BeanUtil: Copies properties through java.lang.reflect.Field/Method; Kotlin data classes are constructed explicitly instead.
classes.cn.hutool.core.clone.CloneSupport: Relies on Object.clone(), which commonMain does not expose.
classes.cn.hutool.core.comparator.PropertyCompar: Needs reflection to read a bean property by name.
classes.cn.hutool.core.convert.Convert: Hutool dispatches on java.lang.reflect.Type; the port keeps explicit toXxx functions, so the registry/converter SPI is intentionally not ported.
classes.cn.hutool.core.convert.ConverterRegistry: Service-loader based converter registry for java.lang.reflect.Type.
classes.cn.hutool.core.date.DateUtil: java.util.Date/Calendar based; kotlinx-datetime replaces it and the signatures differ.
classes.cn.hutool.core.getter.BasicTypeGetter: Interfaces designed for the removed BasicTypeGetter/OptBasicTypeGetter bean layer.
classes.cn.hutool.core.io.FileUtil: Files and streams (java.io/java.nio); cannot exist in commonMain.
classes.cn.hutool.core.lang.ClassScanner: Walks class loaders and jars; no classpath concept in commonMain.
classes.cn.hutool.core.lang.SimpleCache: java.util.concurrent map; replaced by a platform cache when needed.
classes.cn.hutool.core.net.NetUtil: java.net network interfaces and local address probing.
classes.cn.hutool.core.thread.ThreadUtil: java.lang.Thread; no threads in common code.
classes.cn.hutool.core.util.ClassUtil: Class loading, packages and resources through the class loader.
classes.cn.hutool.core.util.TypeUtil: Works on java.lang.reflect.Type and generic signatures.
classes.cn.hutool.core.util.XmlUtil: javax.xml DOM/SAX parsers; no XML parser in the standard library.
classes.cn.hutool.core.clone.DefaultCloneable: Its default clone0() invokes Object.clone() by reflection; commonMain has neither clone nor reflective invocation.
classes.cn.hutool.core.collection.NodeListIter: Wraps org.w3c.dom.NodeList, a JVM/Java-SE API with no common counterpart.
classes.cn.hutool.core.collection.SpliteratorUti: Operates on java.util.Spliterator and java.util.stream; neither exists in commonMain.
classes.cn.hutool.core.collection.TransSpliterat: Transforms java.util.Spliterator instances, a java.util.stream API.
classes.cn.hutool.core.exceptions.CheckedUtil: Adapts checked exceptions through java.lang.reflect and Hutool's JVM functional-interface hierarchy.
classes.cn.hutool.core.lang.Console: Reads/writes java.io.Console and ANSI terminal state; a KMP CLI needs a platform logging/output backend.
classes.cn.hutool.core.lang.generator.ObjectGene: Instantiates objects reflectively from a Class, which commonMain does not expose.
classes.cn.hutool.core.lang.intern.InternUtil: Chooses between JdkStringInterner and WeakInterner, both JVM-only; use an explicit Interner implementation instead.
classes.cn.hutool.core.lang.intern.WeakInterner: Uses java.lang.ref.WeakReference and a JVM reference queue.
classes.cn.hutool.core.lang.Pid: Reads the JVM process id through RuntimeMXBean/ProcessHandle.
classes.cn.hutool.core.map.CaseInsensitiveTreeMa: Backed by java.util.TreeMap and a String CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER comparator; Kotlin common has no TreeMap.
classes.cn.hutool.core.util.JdkUtil: Detects JVM version and runtime properties; there is no JVM in commonMain.
classes.cn.hutool.core.util.JNDIUtil: Uses javax.naming JNDI lookups, a Java SE API.
classes.cn.hutool.core.util.SystemPropsUtil: Reads java.lang.System properties and environment through JVM system calls.
classes.cn.hutool.cache.impl.WeakCache: Stores values through java.lang.ref.WeakReference; common Kotlin has no weak-reference API.
classes.cn.hutool.log.Log: Hutool's logging facade resolves callers and pluggable JVM backends; KMP projects use kotlin-logging instead, so this facade is intentionally out of scope.
classes.cn.hutool.log.StaticLog: Depends on CallerUtil and the JVM LogFactory; replaced by kotlin-logging's KLogger.
